title: 第15章 冰盘水第16章 败露
content_zh:
第一五章 冰盘水
“族牌！”
“登记！”
“选药！”
许是刚刚开门不久的缘故，灵药堂里静悄悄的。坐在门侧暗影中的还是那个秃顶老头，和昨天不同的是，老头今日精神矍铄，上下打量着聂空，两只狭长的小眼睛冒着幽光，像是吃了超剂量的**。
聂空被秃顶老头看得有点毛骨悚然，登记完名字便溜到一排排的药架子前，快速搜寻起来。
白星粉、香丝琉璃根、灵梦草、龙芽藻、冰盘水……如果聂空记忆没错的话，这就是炼制“回春露”的五种药草。
聂空的身影不断从药架前一晃而过。做为世家大族，聂家灵药堂的药物的确非常齐全，香丝琉璃根、龙芽藻、灵梦草和白星粉相继被聂空找到，可直到将最后一排药架看完，冰盘水还是踪影全无。
怎么会没有呢？
在香丝琉璃根等五种药物里面，聂空印象最深的就数冰盘水了，这主要是因为蓟阳城就有它的一处产地，那就是聂家后山的“冰炎洞”。对聂家灵药堂来说，冰盘水应该是应有尽有才对。
“香香，还有多长时间？”
“啊呀呀。”十一分钟。
“……”
只要能找到，应该还能来得及。聂空不死心，于是一排排地往回找。回到第一排药架前，聂空有点茫然，还是没有。
“小家伙，在找冰盘水？”怪笑传来，说话的正是那秃顶老头，现在，他的声音也不一顿一顿了。
“你怎么知道？”聂空脱口道。
“过来。”
秃顶老头笑眯眯地招招手，一副慈眉善目的样子。聂空疑惑地走到他跟前，老头却白眼一翻：“真是笨蛋，你前面取了香丝琉璃根、龙芽藻、灵梦草、白星粉这四种药物，傻子也能看出你还缺少什么了。”
聂空恍然，昨天他拿起药包只用鼻子一闻，就知道药物的名称和重量，可见他对药物的熟悉程度，能看出来不足为奇。
“怎么，想炼‘回春露’？”老头兴致盎然。

“没错。”
聂空点了点头，他没想过能瞒住这老头。
老头眼神中全是同情，道：“小家伙，‘冰盘水’都在二楼，你在这一楼转来转去，就算转到天黑也找不到。”
“啊？”
聂空脑袋发懵。
二楼，那得通灵以上灵师才能上去，他在聂家没有半个朋友，连找人帮忙都找不行，难不成在修为达到通灵一品以前，真的与炼制“回春露”无缘了？
就在聂空绝望时，老头话锋一转，嘿嘿笑了两声：“不过，小家伙你今天运气很好，而且老夫心情也不错，呶，这里是半葫芦‘冰盘水’，是老夫昨晚剩下的，拿回家玩去吧。接着！”
说着，老头从桌底摸出一个红葫芦，随手丢在聂空怀里。
聂空有点忙乱地把它抱住，那红葫芦底部足有饭碗大小，拿在手里，份量颇重，估计有一斤多。真是喜从天降、绝处逢生，聂空有些难以置信，试探着问道：“老先生，你为什么帮我？”
“老夫看你顺眼。”
老头捻着下巴处那几根稀稀疏疏的鼠须，笑得像只狡猾的老狐狸。
这种鬼话只能骗骗小孩子，聂空暗暗腹诽，他可不相信自己会遇到这种天上掉馅饼的好事。心念电转，聂空随即有些明白过来了，昨天自己刚来这里取了天心子和须蝴蝶草等四种药物，今天就修为增长二品，身体大为健壮，这老头肯定是看出了其中的端倪，所以才慷慨送出冰盘水，想看看自己是不是真能炼制出“回春露”。
“多谢老先生。”
聂空道了谢，带着药物和族牌奔出了灵药堂，出门后也只匆匆和聂青锋打了声招呼，便跑得没了影。
只剩六分钟，已经来不及回家，聂空干脆向灵药堂不远处的那片小林子冲去。林木空隙间隐约可见好几个年轻男子，或静坐修炼灵诀，或反复习练灵术，几乎无人关注聂空的突然到来。
这也正和聂空心意，以最快的速度找到处僻静的空间，在树底盘坐下来。
香丝琉璃根五钱，龙芽藻五钱、灵梦草三钱、白星粉二钱……
四种药物依次被聂空放入口中，使劲咀嚼了将近一分钟，聂空才拔出葫芦嘴的小塞子，仰头倒入冰盘水。
聂空打了个寒噤，彻骨的寒意爆炸开来。顷刻间，聂空就浑身发僵，嘴巴更是麻木得没有知觉。
冰盘水，真TM的凉！

聂空赶紧运转“五星挪移诀”，灵神三窍震颤，一部分灵力散溢开来驱除身体的冰冷，另一部分则将刚刚吞咽进去的药物团团包裹，将药力如丝如缕地抽取出来，往灵神三窍汇聚而去。
“啊呀呀。”
小家伙一声欢呼，精致的鼎盖掀开，将药力吸入鼎中。
感觉到香香的异常兴奋，聂空突然有点担心起来，这小家伙会不会监守自盗，把药力全部自己吃掉？
过了近三分钟，香丝琉璃根等五种药力才被全部抽取。对聂空来说，这个吸取药力的速度简直慢得令人发指，如果施展“九转金针”的话，最多一分钟的功夫，就能所有的药力都集中起来。
只剩下一分多钟了。在灵药堂耽搁过长，时间太紧了，聂空有种不妙的预感，这次尝试有九成会以失败而告终。
“噹！”
鼎盖终于阖起。
灵神三窍激烈震动，聂空将全部灵力调动起来，往那小药鼎内部注入。只听嗡的一声颤鸣，静止的药鼎陡然旋转起来，速度之快，让聂空只感觉到一团模糊的绿影，连鼎身、鼎脚都已分辨不出。
“啊呀呀！”小家伙急叫。
聂空还没来得及弄明白香香叫声中的含义，然后就……
“砰！”
药鼎内响起爆鸣。
随后，鼎盖掀开，里面只剩下一点渣渣。
“失败了？”聂空有点傻眼。
“啊……呀呀……”
犹如宝贝玩具被搞坏的小幼童，小家伙气愤得直叫唤，聂空感觉那小小的药鼎似乎有点扭曲。
“小香香。”
聂空讨好地安抚，他有点心虚，这次失败完全是他的责任。
他已意识到，自己实在太心急了，虽然这种炼药方式无需实质上的炉火，可他的灵力起的就是炉火的作用，煎药时要控制火候，用药鼎幻身炼药应该也有这个讲究。真是心急吃不了热豆腐！

“啊呀呀。”
三十分钟到，药鼎幻身消散，香香恢复成小嫩苗，漂浮在瑶池穴的墨绿血液上，根须贴着灵神三窍。
这时，聂空倏地发现，窍穴中竟还残余着点药力，那是属于香丝琉璃根的。看样子，炼制“回春露”时，香丝琉璃根只需四钱就够了。
念头从心中闪过，聂空顿时惊喜起来，没想到小家伙还有这能力，竟能自动调整最合适的药物比例。聂空的沮丧一扫而空，能有这个收获，别说失败一次，就算失败两次也完全值得。
聂空笑意盈盈地观察着小家伙，就见它根须轻轻一颤，毫不客气地把剩余的药力吸收干净……
content_en:
Chapter 15 Ice Plate of Water
"Clan card!"
"Register!"
"Choose medicine!"
Perhaps because it had just opened the door not long ago, the elixir hall was quiet. The old bald man sitting in the shadow beside the door was still the same one. Different from yesterday, the old man was in good spirits today. He looked Nie Kong up and down, his two narrow eyes glowing dimly, as if he had taken an overdose of drugs.
Nie Kong was a little creeped out by the bald old man. After registering his name, he slipped to the rows of medicine shelves and started searching quickly.
White star powder, fragrant silk glazed root, Lingmeng grass, dragon bud algae, ice plate water... If Nie Kong's memory is correct, these are the five herbs used to refine "Rejuvenation Dew".
Nie Kong's figure kept passing by the medicine shelf. As an aristocratic family, the medicines in the Nie family's spiritual medicine hall are indeed very complete. Fragrant silk glazed root, dragon's bud algae, spirit dream grass and white star powder were found by Nie Kong one after another. However, until he finished looking at the last row of medicine shelves, there was still no trace of the ice plate water.
How could it not be?
Among the five medicines including Xiangsi Liuli Root, the one that impressed Nie Kong the most was Bingpan Water. This was mainly because Jiyang City had a place of origin for it, which was the "Bingyan Cave" in the back mountain of Nie's family. For the Nie Family Spiritual Medicine Hall, ice plate water should be everything you need.
"Xiangxiang, how long does it take?"
"Ahhhhh." Eleven minutes.
"..."
As long as you can find it, you should still be able to do it in time. Nie Kong refused to give up, so he went back row by row to look for them. Returning to the first row of medicine shelves, Nie Kong was a little confused, but there was still nothing.
"Little guy, are you looking for water in the ice tray?" A strange laugh came, and it was the bald old man who spoke. Now, his voice was no longer quiet.
"How do you know?" Nie Kong blurted out.
"Come here."
The bald old man smiled and waved, looking kind-hearted. Nie Kong walked up to him in confusion, but the old man rolled his eyes: "What an idiot. You took these four medicines: Fragrant Silk Root, Dragon Bud Algae, Lingmeng Grass, and White Star Powder. Even a fool can see what you are missing."
Nie Kong suddenly realized that yesterday he picked up the medicine package and just smelled it with his nose, and he knew the name and weight of the medicine. It was not surprising that he was familiar with the medicine.
"What, you want to practice the 'Rejuvenating Dew'?" The old man was very interested.
"That's right."
Nie Kong nodded, he never thought that he could hide this from the old man.
The old man's eyes were full of sympathy and he said: "Little guy, the 'Bing Pan Shui' is on the second floor. If you wander around on this floor, you won't be able to find it even if it gets dark."
"Huh?"
Nie Kong was confused.
On the second floor, you have to be a psychic or above to go up there. He doesn't have any friends in the Nie family, and he can't even find anyone to help him. Is it possible that he really has no chance of refining "Rejuvenation Dew" before he reaches the first level of psychic cultivation?
Just when Nie Kong was despairing, the old man changed the topic and chuckled twice: "But, little guy, you are very lucky today, and I am in a good mood. Hey, here is half a gourd of 'ice plate water', which I left last night. Take it home and play. Then!"
As he spoke, the old man took out a red gourd from under the table and threw it into Nie Kong's arms.
Nie Kong hugged it a little hurriedly. The bottom of the red gourd was about the size of a rice bowl. In his hand, it was quite heavy, probably more than a pound. It was such joy that fell from the sky and life came from a desperate situation. Nie Kong was a little unbelievable and asked tentatively: "Old sir, why did you help me?"
"I like you."
The old man twirled the sparse rat whiskers on his chin and smiled like a cunning old fox.
This kind of nonsense can only deceive children, Nie Kong secretly cursed, he did not believe that he would encounter such a good thing like pie in the sky. Nie Kong's mind turned and he understood something. He had just come here yesterday to take four kinds of medicine including Tianxinzi and Butterfly Grass. Today, his cultivation had increased by two levels and his body was much stronger. The old man must have seen the clues, so he was so generous.He generously gave away the ice tray of water to see if he could really refine the "Rejuvenation Dew".
"Thank you, old sir."
Nie Kong thanked him and ran out of the elixir hall with the medicine and clan cards. After leaving the house, he only said hello to Nie Qingfeng in a hurry and disappeared.
With only six minutes left and no time to go home, Nie Kong simply rushed towards the small forest not far from the Spiritual Medicine Hall. Several young men could be vaguely seen in the gaps between the trees, either sitting quietly practicing spiritual techniques or repeatedly practicing spiritual techniques. Almost no one paid attention to Nie Kong's sudden arrival.
This was exactly what Nie Kong wanted, so he found a secluded space as quickly as possible and sat down under the tree.
Five qian for fragrant silk glazed root, five qian for dragon's bud algae, three qian for Lingmeng grass, two qian for white star powder...
Nie Kong put the four medicines into his mouth one after another and chewed them vigorously for nearly a minute. Then he pulled out the stopper from the gourd mouth and poured the water into the ice tray.
Nie Kong shivered, and the bone-chilling chill exploded. In an instant, Nie Kong's whole body became stiff, and his mouth was so numb that he couldn't feel anything.
The water in the ice tray is so fucking cold!
Nie Kong quickly ran the "Five Star Movement Technique", causing the three spiritual orifices to tremble. Part of the spiritual power spread out to drive away the coldness in the body, while the other part wrapped the medicine that had just been swallowed, extracted the power of the medicine like threads, and gathered it towards the three spiritual orifices.
"Ahhhhh."
The little guy cheered, opened the delicate lid of the cauldron, and sucked the medicinal power into the cauldron.
Feeling Xiangxiang's unusual excitement, Nie Kong suddenly became a little worried. Will this little guy keep it secret and take all the medicine by himself?
After nearly three minutes, all the five medicinal powers including fragrant silk and glazed root were extracted. For Nie Kong, the speed of absorbing the power of the medicine is extremely slow. If he uses the "Nine-turn Golden Needle", it will take at most one minute to concentrate all the power of the medicine.
Just over a minute left. After spending too long in the elixir hall and being too short on time, Nie Kong had a bad feeling that 90% of the time this attempt would end in failure.
"Dang!"
The lid of the tripod was finally closed.
The three spiritual orifices vibrated violently, and Nie Kong mobilized all his spiritual power and poured it into the small medicine cauldron. There was only a buzzing sound, and the still medicine cauldron suddenly started to rotate. The speed was so fast that Nie Kong could only feel a blur of green shadow, and even the body and legs of the cauldron could not be distinguished.
"Ah ah ah!" the little guy yelled urgently.
Nie Kong didn't have time to understand the meaning of Xiangxiang's cry, and then...
"Bang!"
There was an explosion in the medicine cauldron.
Then, the lid of the cauldron was lifted, leaving only a little bit of dregs inside.
"Failed?" Nie Kong was a little dumbfounded.
"Ah...yeah..."
Like a little kid whose precious toy has been broken, the little guy screamed angrily. Nie Kong felt that the little medicine cauldron seemed a little twisted.
"Xiao Xiangxiang."
Nie Kong comforted him in a flattering manner. He felt a little guilty and this failure was entirely his responsibility.
He has realized that he is too impatient. Although this method of refining medicine does not require an actual fire, his spiritual power plays the role of the fire. When decoction, the heat must be controlled, and the use of medicine cauldron to make medicine should also have this emphasis. I’m so impatient that I can’t eat hot tofu!
"Ahhhhh."
Thirty minutes later, the medicine cauldron dissipated, and the fragrance returned to small tender seedlings, floating on the dark green blood in Yaochi Point, with roots sticking to the three spiritual orifices.
At this time, Nie Kong suddenly discovered that there was still some medicinal power left in the acupoints, which belonged to the root of Xiangsi Liuli. It seems that when refining the "Rejuvenation Dew", only four coins of fragrant silk and glazed roots are enough.
The thought flashed through his mind, and Nie Kong was suddenly pleasantly surprised. He didn't expect that the little guy had the ability to automatically adjust the most suitable drug ratio. Nie Kong's frustration was swept away. With this gain, not to mention failing once, even failing twice was completely worth it.
Nie Kong observed the little guy with a smile, and saw that its roots trembled slightly, and he unceremoniously poured out the remaining potion.Absorb cleanly...
